source: knowledge/web/inspiration-and-tools.md (robots.txt, llms.txt, homepages and category URLs fetched 2026-10-15 with curl/WebFetch; X handles resolved through api.fxtwitter.com; earlier ToS reads in knowledge/ecosystem/reference-sources.md, 2026-10-08)

automatable.mcp: official MCP server for agents; use interactively per brief, never loop it to mirror the library
automatable.api: official JSON API (key or no key as noted)
automatable.rss: official feed or sitemap; poll at most daily
automatable.fetch-polite: robots.txt allows the path for agents and no ToS clause found against it: one human-picked page per brief, <=1 req/s, descriptive UA, store pointers only
automatable.manual: bot challenge, 403/429, robots or ToS disallows agents, or login wall: a human browses; the engine only receives URLs
automatable.founder-account: needs the founder's paid login (OAuth MCP or browser); the engine prepares the exact queries
automatable.local-tool: an app, plugin or extension a human runs; the engine replicates the function in code
automatable.package: npm/pip package or open-source code the engine can install and run

legend.free: true = core content free to view; 'freemium' = partial; false = paid
legend.loginNeeded: true = content not visible without login; 'partial' = list visible, detail or filters gated
legend.evidence: F fetched 2026-10-15 | R robots.txt read 2026-10-15 | P prior note (knowledge/ecosystem/reference-sources.md, 2026-10-08) | S secondary | M memory, verify

sources.name: Recent (ex-Godly)
sources.notes: godly.website 301 -> recent.design/?ref=godly. Revived 2026 as a broader feed (X, Instagram, sites, tools). robots: User-agent * Allow /. No terms or llms.txt found. Highest motion/craft taste among free galleries; no category filter URLs for SaaS. [F,R]

sources.name: Land-book
sources.categoryUrlPattern: item /websites/<id>-<slug>; filters are query params (?industry= ?style= ?color= ?platform=) and are DISALLOWED in robots
sources.notes: robots explicitly welcomes ClaudeBot/Claude-User but disallows /api/ and every filter/sort/search param. rss.xml returned 200 (latest 50); homepage and sitemap.xml returned a Cloudflare challenge (403) to curl on 2026-10-15: do not solve it, browse by hand. Credit designer + link back. [F,R,P]

sources.name: SaaSFrame
sources.categoryUrlPattern: /categories/<slug> (pricing-page, landing-page, features-page, comparison-page, ai-page, dashboard, onboarding, settings, changelog, 404-page...) | /patterns/<slug> (bento-grid, call-to-action, ai-chat, ai-generation-state, clients-logo...) | /brands | /best-landing-pages
sources.notes: SaaS-only, best category fit for marketing sections and product screens. robots changed since 2026-10-08: now User-agent * with no disallow, 'Content-Signal: ai-train=no, search=yes, ai-input=yes', GPTBot disallowed. Agent reading for a brief is signalled OK; never train or store images. Pro ~$18/mo for full browse + Figma files [P]. [F,R]

sources.name: Mobbin
sources.notes: MCP (OAuth, Pro $10/mo yearly or $15/mo quarterly) and REST (Team+), 60 req/60 s, honour Retry-After. llms.txt + llms-full.txt + .md pages for agents. ToS: no caching/archiving, no AI train/test/benchmark, no repository from MCP output; keep product name + Mobbin URL. Website sections cover heroes, pricing, nav, testimonials, footers. [F,P]

sources.name: Refero
sources.notes: Paid MCP (8,000 calls/month/user [P]) with styles, screens, flows; Refero Skill at github.com/referodesign/refero_skill; Figma plugin. ToS forbids training/evaluating ML with content and storing results. robots: all allowed except GPTBot. [F,R,P]

sources.name: Page Flows
sources.notes: Recorded onboarding/checkout/upgrade flows. robots allows / (disallows /search and ?next= ?flow_slug ?number=); most recordings paid. Use for flow structure notes only. screenlane.com redirects here [P]. [F,R]

sources.name: Lapa Ninja
sources.notes: Cloudflare 403 to curl and WebFetch; Browser pane blocked by site permissions (2026-10-15). Human browsing only. Volume-driven, mixed quality. [F]

sources.name: Awwwards
sources.categoryUrlPattern: /websites/<slug>/ (saas, web-interactive, business-corporate, data-visualization, 3d, animation, clean, about-page, 404-pages...)
sources.notes: Path categories return 200 and are not disallowed, but /websites/? filters, /tag/, /gallery/, /feed, /elements/* are. ToS: all rights reserved, no commercial use without authorisation [S]. Creative/studio bias, not SaaS; use for motion ambition. [F,R]

sources.name: Siteinspire
sources.notes: robots allows Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot and /api/mcp, blocks ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai and (for *) /websites/categories/. curl got a 429 Vercel checkpoint on 2026-10-15: use the MCP, never crawl. Index data usable for non-commercial research with attribution [P]. Editorial/type-led taste. [F,R,P]

sources.name: Minimal Gallery
sources.notes: WordPress; robots allows all but /wp-admin/. Restrained, whitespace-led sites; good for light editorial grammars. Terms at /legal not read. [F,R]

sources.name: Dark
sources.categoryUrlPattern: /site/<slug> ; client-side filters All, Agency, AI, Culture, Education, Hardware, Personal, Software, Web3 (no URL) ; /templates
sources.notes: ~247 hand-picked dark sites (WebFetch count). robots: Allow /. No terms visible; product by Y5K LLC. First stop for premium dark folds. [F,R]

sources.name: Dark Mode Design
sources.notes: robots lists only a sitemap (no rules). Older, broader dark gallery; lower SaaS density than dark.design. [F,R]

sources.name: Layers
sources.notes: Designer portfolio/posts community. robots.txt 404; explore renders client-side (no designs in fetched HTML). Browse by hand; follow designers found here on X. [F]

sources.name: Cosmos
sources.notes: Pinterest alternative for creatives; search by hex colour and visual similarity; AI attribution captions. robots: Claude-User allowed, * disallows /*?* and /api/. Premium $8/mo. Best used as the founder's own taste board. [F,R]

sources.name: Savee
sources.categoryUrlPattern: MCP https://mcp.savee.com/mcp (read-only, OAuth 2.1) ; REST https://api.savee.com/v1/ (personal token)
sources.notes: MCP and API read the member's own saves/boards and search the public library; subscription needed. ToS forbids scraping and AI training/evaluation; keep IDs/links only [P]. robots disallows /search/, /feed/, /api/. [F,R,P]

sources.name: Footer
sources.notes: By NOOON Studio; llms.txt present; robots allows all. Pair with knowledge/web/footers.md (49 measured). [F,R]

sources.name: Navbar Gallery
sources.notes: 450+ navbars from live sites by Christina Liubynska; llms.txt; robots lists only a sitemap. Pair with knowledge/web/nav-grammars.md. [F,R]

sources.name: CTA Gallery
sources.notes: robots Allow /. Section crops of closing CTAs; template-heavy, check for Framer/Webflow template sources. [F,R]

sources.name: Supahero
sources.notes: Hero-section library, now part of screensdesign.com. robots.txt 404; Browser pane blocked by site permissions. Pricing page exists; terms not read. [F]

sources.name: Hero Gallery
sources.categoryUrlPattern: /hero-gallery/<brand> ; tags SaaS, Fintech, Productivity, Creative Tools, Built with Framer/Webflow; filters by layout, copy, CTA type, tone, trust signals
sources.notes: Heroes 'tagged, audited' with written opinions on copy/CTA; strong for hero copy and CTA grammar audits. robots Allow /. Terms not read. [F,R]

sources.name: herosection.design
sources.notes: Homepage redirects to /lander (looks parked) on 2026-10-15; not a working gallery. Re-check later. [F]

sources.name: Landing.Gallery
sources.notes: Public no-auth MCP: search_inspiration (max 4 results) and get_website(slug). ToS: no bulk download; automated tools need written consent beyond the MCP [P]. robots disallows /api/ (the MCP is the sanctioned route). [F,R,P]

sources.name: Curated
sources.notes: MCP tools plan_page, search_sections, get_section, get_design_system, search_sites, get_site, list_facets, whoami; Pro $9/mo or $84/yr (OAuth or crd_ key). Terms: reference/study allowed; wholesale scraping, redistribution and republishing forbidden. Closest gallery to the engine's own pipeline (brief -> section plan -> design system). [F,R]

sources.name: One Page Love
sources.categoryUrlPattern: /inspiration/<genre> (app, saas, landing-page, finance, announcement, ...) ; /sections ; API https://onepagelove.com/api
sources.notes: 9,000+ human-curated entries; acquired 2026 by Piet Terheyden. robots and llms.txt tell agents to use the API (filters genre, style, platform, tech, typeface, colour, section; Retina screenshots; free tier, key in seconds). Status changed from waitlist (2026-10-08) to open. [F,R]

sources.name: maxibestof.one
sources.notes: robots allows / (disallows /go/, /api/), but curl and WebFetch got a Cloudflare challenge (403). Content not verified this pass. Human browsing only. [F,R]

sources.name: Httpster
sources.notes: ~3,116 hand-selected sites [P], type-led identity. robots.txt returns 404 (no rules). [F]

sources.name: SaaS Landing Page
sources.notes: Section-level SaaS crops; robots allows all. Already in knowledge/benchmarks/sections/targets-galleries.json. [F,R]

sources.name: Saaspo
sources.notes: 403 challenge to curl and robots.txt. Human only. [F]

sources.name: Framer Marketplace
sources.notes: robots allows paths (disallows ?sort= ?query= etc.); 'Content-Signal: ai-train=yes, search=yes, ai-input=yes'; llms.txt. The commodity baseline: what a $79 template already does. Measure previews, never copy. [F,R]

sources.name: Dribbble
sources.notes: Concept shots, not shipped pages. robots allows /tags/ and /search/ but disallows /shots/day|week|month, /*/tags/*, colors; curl got 202 (challenge). Illustration and mood only. [F,R]

sources.name: Behance
sources.notes: robots disallows ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, Claude-Web and other AI agents site-wide; search returned 403. Human browsing only; brand case studies. [F,R]

sources.name: v0 templates
sources.notes: robots has no disallows. Community templates on shadcn/Tailwind: shows what an AI default looks like (anti-reference) and occasionally a good component. [F,R]

sources.name: Lovable templates
sources.notes: robots allows Claude-User on / except /auth, /projects/, /@*, /landing. AI-default baseline, as v0. [F,R]

sources.name: Fonts In Use
sources.notes: Archive of typography in real work. robots blocks GPTBot, SiteSucker and some AI agents; treat as human reading. [F,R]

sources.name: Typewolf
sources.notes: Jeremiah Shoaf's type-trend site and pairing lists. robots disallows /sites-using-free-fonts and /all-sites. Read by hand for pairings and trend names. [F,R]

fonts.name: Fontsource API
fonts.notes: No key; returns subsets, weights, variable, category, license (e.g. Geist OFL-1.1). npm @fontsource/<id> and @fontsource-variable/<id>. robots: Content-Signal ai-train=yes, ai-input=yes. [F]

fonts.name: Fontshare API
fonts.notes: No key; returns per-font OpenType feature tags (aalt, ss01, tnum, frac...). Satoshi, General Sans, Switzer, Cabinet Grotesk, Clash Display/Grotesk. Mostly ITF Free Font License: commercial use OK, no redistribution of files [S]: never commit them to a public repo. [F]

fonts.name: Google Fonts
fonts.notes: OFL/Apache. Official API needs a free key. fonts.google.com/metadata/fonts answered 200 (2.7 MB) but is undocumented: prefer Fontsource. robots disallows /license/. [F,R,P]

fonts.name: Pangram Pangram
fonts.notes: Free trial fonts are personal, non-commercial only; client work needs a paid licence (Desktop/Web/App sold separately) [S]. Mockups only, never ship trial files. [S]

fonts.name: Velvetyne
fonts.notes: Libre display faces, typically OFL, per-font GitHub repos [M]. Verify licence per font. [F]

fonts.name: Collletttivo
fonts.notes: Italian open-source type collective; robots allows *. Licence per font (mostly OFL) [M]. [F,R]

fonts.name: Uncut
fonts.notes: Curated catalogue of free/libre typefaces (links to the designers' own licences). Returned 'Checking your browser' (454); robots disallows ?queries and /downloads/*. Human only. [F,R]

fonts.name: Wakamai Fondue
fonts.notes: Shows a font's OpenType features, axes, glyph coverage and generates CSS. Engine equivalent: opentype.js (already pinned for logo tools) or fontTools; Fontshare API lists features directly. [M]

fonts.name: Fontpair / Fontjoy / Typescale
fonts.notes: Pairing and scale generators for Google Fonts. Low taste ceiling; system/variety/type-voices.json is the engine's pairing source. [F]

colour.name: tints.dev
colour.notes: Returns a Tailwind 50-950 scale in oklch() as JSON, no key (verified with blue/3b82f6). Fastest programmatic ramp; still check contrast. [F]

colour.name: Radix Colors
colour.notes: 12-step light/dark scales with defined roles (1-2 bg, 3-5 component, 6-8 border, 9-10 solid, 11-12 text); MIT. Already used by knowledge/web/_color-tools/radix.py. [M]

colour.name: UI Colors
colour.notes: Tailwind palette generator with in-context previews and Figma plugin. No public API found. [F]

colour.name: OKLCH Color Picker
colour.notes: Evil Martians' picker showing gamut (sRGB/P3/Rec2020). Engine equivalent: culori in Node. [F]

colour.name: Huetone
colour.notes: Builds accessible palettes on LCH/OKLCH with APCA/WCAG contrast grids; open source [M]. robots allows all. [F,R]

colour.name: Coolors
colour.notes: No public API; trending palettes are crowd taste, not SaaS taste. By hand only. [F,R,P]

colour.name: Realtime Colors
colour.notes: Previews 5 colours + Google Font pair on a sample site, exports CSS/Tailwind. Repo CC BY-NC-ND: never fork or embed [P]. [F]

colour.name: Grainient
colour.notes: Basit A. Khan's library of 1,000+ grainy/animated gradient backgrounds up to 8K; subscription [S]. Licence on site not read: check before a client ships one. Engine recreates the look in code (system/variety/basit-tokens.json). [F,S]

colour.name: gradient.page
colour.notes: Vercel security checkpoint (429) to curl on 2026-10-15; content not verified. [F]

colour.name: Paper Shaders
colour.notes: Open-source WebGL2 shaders, npm @paper-design/shaders and @paper-design/shaders-react (28 shaders, pre-1.0: pin exact version); speed 0 = static zero-cost render; needs a WebGL2 fallback. [F,S]

colour.name: fffuel
colour.categoryUrlPattern: /<tool>/ (nnnoise, gggrain, bbblurry, llline, ssscribble, hhholographic, pppixelate, rrrasterize, tttexture, ...)
colour.notes: 70+ SVG generators by Sébastien Noël. Licence: commercial OK, no attribution needed, no resale/redistribution of the images. Engine copies the technique (feTurbulence noise, blur blobs) into code. [F]

colour.name: Haikei
colour.notes: SVG blobs, waves, layered steps, low-poly. robots allows all. Easy to look 2021-template; use sparingly. [F,R]

colour.name: Mesh
colour.notes: Mesh-gradient generator. Prefer Paper Shaders MeshGradient in code. [F]

tools.name: v0
tools.notes: Prompt-to-React on shadcn/Tailwind; good for component scaffolds; output defaults to the shadcn look. Learn: registry blocks, iterate-by-diff. [F]

tools.name: Lovable
tools.notes: Prompt-to-full-stack app (Supabase). Learn: plan-then-build, visual edit mode. Output is the AI-default baseline. [F]

tools.name: Bolt
tools.notes: StackBlitz WebContainer builder; fast prototypes, weak taste. [F]

tools.name: Google Stitch (ex Galileo AI)
tools.notes: Galileo acquired by Google mid-2025; Stitch 2.0 (March 2026) adds multi-screen generation (up to 5 linked screens), infinite canvas, prototyping; free in beta with daily credits; exports Figma/HTML; generic without heavy prompting [S].

tools.name: Magic Patterns
tools.notes: AI prototyping for product teams with design-system import. Learn: generate inside the team's component library. [F]

tools.name: Relume
tools.notes: Sitemap -> wireframe -> style guide -> Figma/Webflow/React. Learn: sitemap-first section planning (cf. curated.design plan_page). Output is wireframe-generic. [F,M]

tools.name: Framer AI / Wireframer
tools.notes: Prompt-to-Framer layouts; result reads as a template. Learn: responsive breakpoints and CMS-backed sections. [M]

tools.name: Subframe
tools.notes: Visual editor that outputs React + Tailwind tied to a component library. Learn: design and code share one source. [F]

tools.name: Paper
tools.notes: Design canvas built on real HTML/CSS with shaders and agent (MCP) access; Kargul Studio lists Paper in its toolset. Learn: code-native canvas, shader export (Paper Shaders). [F]

tools.name: Figma MCP (Dev Mode / remote)
tools.notes: Already listed in this session's deferred tools; the design plugin MCP needs the founder to authorise. Lets the engine read frames as specs and push built pages into Figma. [F]

tools.name: Autoflow
tools.notes: Draws flow arrows between frames. Engine equivalent: SVG connectors in a flow page. [M]

tools.name: Stark
tools.notes: Contrast, vision simulation, focus order. Engine equivalent: check.mjs contrast + axe. [M]

tools.name: Contrast (plugin)
tools.notes: Live WCAG contrast while designing. Engine equivalent: check.mjs. [M]

tools.name: Iconify
tools.notes: 200k+ open icons; API exposes per-set licence (Lucide ISC, Phosphor MIT, Tabler MIT) [P].

tools.name: Unsplash
tools.notes: Hotlink API URLs, credit photographer, no ML/dataset use [P].

tools.name: Content Reel
tools.notes: Realistic names, avatars, text strings. Engine equivalent: internally coherent sample data labelled sample. [M]

tools.name: html.to.design / Builder.io Visual Copilot / Anima / Locofy
tools.notes: Web->Figma and Figma->code converters. Engine: prefer the Figma MCP send_code_to_figma for handoff. [M]

tools.name: VisBug
tools.notes: Point-and-edit any page: spacing, type, alignment. Engine equivalent: Playwright evaluate + check.mjs probes. [M]

tools.name: CSS Peeper
tools.notes: Extracts colours, fonts, assets from a page. Engine equivalent: extract-design-system skill / teardown-measure.js. [F]

tools.name: WhatFont / Fontanello
tools.notes: Identify font family, size, weight, OpenType features on hover. Engine equivalent: getComputedStyle + document.fonts. [M]

tools.name: ColorZilla
tools.notes: Eyedropper, gradient generator, page colour analyser. Engine equivalent: computed colours by area weight. [F]

tools.name: Page Ruler
tools.notes: Measure px distances on a page. Engine equivalent: getBoundingClientRect diffs in check.mjs. [M]

tools.name: Responsively
tools.notes: Open-source multi-viewport browser. Engine equivalent: shot.mjs at 390/768/1440. [F]

tools.name: Polypane
tools.notes: Paid multi-pane dev browser with a11y overlays. Engine equivalent: check.mjs + multi-viewport shots. [F]

tools.name: CleanShot X
tools.notes: Screenshots, scrolling capture, annotations. Engine equivalent: shot.mjs --full. [F]

tools.name: Raycast
tools.notes: Launcher with colour picker, snippets, AI; also a design reference itself. [M]

tools.name: ColorSlurp
tools.notes: Screen colour picker with contrast checker. [F]

tools.name: xScope
tools.notes: Rulers, loupe, guides, overlays on screen. Engine equivalent: compare.mjs onion-skin overlay. [F,M]

tools.name: Rotato
tools.notes: 3D device mockups and camera-move animations. Engine replica: CSS 3D transform rig or three.js device frame rendered by record.mjs. [F]

tools.name: Screen Studio
tools.notes: Screen recordings with auto-zoom on clicks, smoothed cursor, padded gradient background. Engine replica: Playwright scripted cursor path + CSS scale/translate zoom keyed to clicks, recorded with tools/record.mjs. [F]

tools.name: Shots
tools.notes: Screenshot-in-mockup compositions for posts. robots disallows all bots. [F,R]

tools.name: Pika
tools.notes: Screenshot on a styled background (padding, radius, shadow, gradient) for X posts. Engine replica: an HTML frame template sized to system/variety/x-post-formats.json, exported by shot.mjs. [F]
